ShipModule.Name: Cardassian Galor Hull Plate (Medium)
ShipModule.Description: Hull plate of uridium alloy, a staple of Cardassian shipbuilding. Plain, in the ochre of the Union's fleets, and sound enough to bring a ship home. "...could not defend itself against one Cardassian warship..." (Gul Jasad, DS9: "Emissary") Gives almost no protection against fire; it is there to soak up damage. Of the Cardassian ship plates of its size, it is the cheapest to build and the easiest to repair, but the most fragile.
